title: A plan for an interrupt-window bug lists each statement between the call that creates the resource and the block that releases it, and gives each its own planted case
goal: The sprint skill's plan step, for a lock or interrupt story, lists every statement between the call that creates or installs a resource and the try that releases it and plants one case per statement, so a fix that closes only part of the window is not found by the review

run: import sys; t = open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md').read(); i = t.index('a lock or concurrency story'); sys.exit(0 if 'each statement between' in t[i:i + 1500] else 1)
